long_description:
Would you like to learn some Bollywood dance steps combined with fitness? Join us for a fun filled night of music and dancing. Join us on November 5th from 6 PM to 8 PM. One free drink and snack included with ticket. This event is open to adults disabilities and made possible by the Robertson Family Foundation. 

Registration is limited, so please reserve your ticket at: https://donate.esteamedcoffee.com/event/bollywood-dance-fitness-11-5/e836450
